senses.sense_definition: op de dag die volgt op de genoemde dag

examples.text: Hij vertrok laat in de avond en kwam <w>anderendaags</w> in de ochtend aan.

target_lang_translations.en: He left late in the evening and arrived <w>the next day</w> in the morning.

examples.text: Het feest duurde tot diep in de nacht en <w>anderendaags</w> was iedereen erg moe.

target_lang_translations.en: The party lasted until deep into the night and <w>the following day</w> everyone was very tired.

target_lang_definitions.en: On the day following the day mentioned

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: referring to the day immediately after a specific event
a slightly more formal way to refer to the day after
